metric_family_warning: These numbers are NOT point-adjusted F1 and are NOT the flat range-based F1 reported in mtsad_reported_results.json. They are the affiliation family (Aff-F, affiliation F1; A-R, affiliation recall) as printed by the CATCH paper. Reading them against a point-adjusted table would be a category error, and this file exists to keep the two families separate.
extraction_method: pdftotext -layout on papers/literature/mtsad_pdfs/xie2024_catch.pdf, Table 2 rows, transcribed column by column.

notes: The CATCH paper evaluates ten real-world datasets (CICIDS, CalIt2, SWAT, Credit, GECCO, Genesis, MSL, NYC, PSM, SMD, SMAP) plus synthetic families; only the five datasets shared with this artifact are transcribed here.

Under the affiliation family the five-dataset ordering is very different from the point-adjusted ordering: SMAP is the hardest column for every method here, while the point-adjusted tables put SMAP near the top.
Only 5 of the 16 methods overlap the models re-run in this artifact, and none of the overlapping numbers can be compared directly with the re-runs, because the metric family differs.
